tools.name: glm_chat
tools.description:
Send a message to the GLM chat API and return the response text.

Single-turn usage (backward compatible):
    glm_chat(message="Hello")
    glm_chat(message="Hello", system="Be helpful")

message.description: The user message (single-turn). Mutually exclusive with messages.

model.description: The GLM model to use (default: glm-4-flash).

system.description:
Optional system prompt (single-turn only; ignored when
messages= is used).

messages.description:
Full conversation history (multi-turn). Mutually
exclusive with message.

fallback_model.description:
Model to switch to when fallback is triggered.
Defaults to 'glm-4.7' when None.

avoid_peak_hours.description:
If True and auto_fallback=True, pre-emptively switch
to fallback model during peak hours (UTC+8 14:00-18:00).

auto_fallback.description:
Global fallback switch. When False, disables all fallback
logic and raises RuntimeError on 429/503/timeout/connection errors
(original behavior).

top_p.description:
Nucleus sampling probability (0.0–1.0). Defaults to 0.95
(GLM-5 recommended range 0.9–0.95 for general chat). When None,
omitted from the API call.

tools.name: glm_embed
tools.description: Generate a text embedding vector using the GLM API.

model.description: The embedding model to use (default: embedding-3).

tools.name: glm_ocr
tools.description:
Extract text from a document or image using the GLM OCR API.

Accepts HTTP/HTTPS document URLs, Base64-encoded file data, ``data:`` URIs,
or local file paths. Local files are automatically read and encoded as
Base64. Bare Base64 strings (without a ``data:`` prefix) are automatically
prefixed with ``data:application/pdf;base64,``.

file.description: HTTP/HTTPS URL, Base64 string, ``data:`` URI, or local file path.

model.description: OCR model to use. Defaults to ``glm-ocr``.

start_page_id.description:
First page to process for multi-page PDFs (1-based).
If ``None``, the API default is used.

end_page_id.description:
Last page to process for multi-page PDFs (1-based).
If ``None``, the API default is used.

days.description: Number of past days to summarize (default: 7).

tools.name: glm_translate
tools.description:
Translate text into the target language using GLM.

Produces pure single-language output without mixing other languages,
solving the Chinese–Japanese mixed-output problem common with general LLMs.

style.description:
Translation style — 'formal' (official documents) or 'casual'
(conversational). Defaults to 'formal'.

fallback_model.description:
Model to switch to on retriable errors.
Defaults to 'glm-4.7' when None.

temperature.description:
Sampling temperature (0.0–2.0). Defaults to 1.0 (neutral
value for GLM-4.7 Plan B where top_p is the primary control).

top_p.description:
Nucleus sampling probability (0.0–1.0). Defaults to 0.8
(GLM-4.7 Plan B stable technical output). When None, omitted
from the API call.

tools.name: glm_vision
tools.description:
Analyze an image using the GLM multimodal vision API.

Accepts HTTP/HTTPS image URLs or Base64-encoded image data. Bare Base64
strings (without a ``data:`` prefix) are automatically prefixed with
``data:image/png;base64,``.

image_url.description: HTTP/HTTPS URL or Base64-encoded image string.

prompt.description: Instruction or question about the image.

model.description: Vision model to use. Defaults to ``glm-4.6v``.

max_tokens.description: Maximum tokens in the response. Must be > 0.

detail.description: Image detail level for the API: "auto", "low", or "high".

fallback_model.description:
Model used when fallback is triggered. Defaults to
``glm-4.6v-flash`` (same-generation free variant).

avoid_peak_hours.description:
Pre-emptively switch to fallback during peak hours
(UTC+8 14:00–18:00) when auto_fallback is also True.

auto_fallback.description:
Enable automatic fallback on retriable errors
(429, 503, timeout, connection errors).

temperature.description:
Sampling temperature (0.0–2.0). Defaults to 0.2 for
focused, stable visual analysis.

top_p.description:
Nucleus sampling probability (0.0–1.0). Defaults to 0.9.
When None, the parameter is omitted from the API call.
